title: The final epilogue line 'The guard at the gate never once asked your name' sits oddly next to the live text from that same crossing moments earlier, 'One of them will not meet your eye' — the two read as mildly contradictory accounts of the same gate guards' reaction.
where: Marrowgate, South Gate (live text) vs. final status epilogue
